"Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." Nikos mutters "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
